verdict.rationale: Flagright's homepage claims in-product 'explainable AI agents' for AML operations and 'AI-native workflows' in case management, so an in-product investigation agent plausibly exists. Beyond those one-line marketing claims, nothing documents the agent investigating transaction alerts or drafting review notes. The alerts/cases APIs are developer building blocks, and the docs MCP server serves documentation only, so neither earns credit. Missing for 10: documentation that the agent investigates specific transaction alerts, evidence it generates review or case notes, any workflow detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
